datasets.title: Andorra Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 7.5 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 77% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 1 year, 3 months ( Last edited 4 months ago ) and 1% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Andorra and exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoJSON, KML, GeoPackage). The dataset represents approximately 77% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 1 year 3 months and continuous community updates.
